FNDN.title: Royco Foundation
FNDN.description: Root owner of the protocol. Manages roles and delays behind the 72-hour timelock, unpauses contracts, and handles emergency oracle actions and fee claims.

WAY.title: Operations
WAY.description: The proposer. Schedules every delayed parameter update and upgrade: core protocol changes at 72 hours, entry-point configuration at 24 hours.

FNDN_VETO.title: Veto Council
FNDN_VETO.description: Dedicated fast-response guardian. Cancels any scheduled operation during its timelock window, with no delay.

WAY_PAUSE.title: Pause Council
WAY_PAUSE.description: Dedicated pause multisig. Can pause every protocol contract immediately; unpausing belongs to the Foundation.

DIAL.title: Strategy Allocator
DIAL.description: Operations multisig for vault strategies. Allocates and deallocates funds between strategies and manages vault withdrawals.

AUTO.title: Service Provider
AUTO.description: Contracted service provider. Grants and revokes tranche LP roles as an operational duty.
